title: Earth has warmed more than 1°C above pre-industrial levels
description: Global mean surface temperature anomaly relative to the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline. Each data point marks a milestone decade, walking through the warming curve from the late 19th century to the hottest year on record.
insight: The pace of warming has roughly doubled since 2015 — from 0.19°C to 0.35°C per decade — and 2024 crossed 1.29°C above pre-industrial levels.

source.name: NOAA / NASA GISS / IPCC AR6 (via Wikipedia: Instrumental temperature record)
